title: The Protocol of Kepler Reach
author: Elodie Brightwater
blurb: Emrys Ishikawa, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
